His Story

A Life Fully Lived

Birth

Festus Mosirigwa Nyangw'ara (Toto) was born in 1987 in Mwamogesa village, Kiamwasi Location, Kisii County. He was the son of Nyagw'ara Ombese and Priscah Bochere. He was brother to the late Jacklyne, Carolyne, Gladys, Lydiah, Hon. Denis Nyangwara, Violet, Laban, Domittillah, Anthonellah, Maurine, Clinton, and Miriam.

Education

Festus began his schooling at St. Peters Academy in baby class, then attended Daraja Mbili and Kiamwasi Primary, where he completed Class Eight. He later joined Nyambera for Form One and completed Form Four at Daraja-mbili Secondary School.

Occupation & Christian Life

Toto ventured into business, selling fruits including oranges alongside his elder brother. He later assisted in hotel management, always working with dedication and quiet determination. He was a committed member of the Seventh Day Adventist Church in Daraja-mbili.

His Final Years

Toto led a relatively healthy life until 2021, when he was diagnosed with diabetes. He battled the illness with remarkable courage for almost five years — always on and off at Bosongo Hospital, where he ultimately succumbed. He passed at the tender age of 39, leaving behind his beloved parents and his siblings.

His Journey

Milestones of a Life Well Lived

1987
A New Life in Mwamogesa
Born to Nyagw'ara Ombese and Priscah Bochere in Mwamogesa village, Kiamwasi Location, Kisii County — a son, a brother, a gift.
1994
Initiation into Adulthood
Initiated into adulthood according to Kisii customary laws — stepping into responsibility and manhood with the blessing of his community.
Early years
Education — St. Peters Academy
Began schooling at St. Peters Academy in baby class, then Daraja Mbili and Kiamwasi Primary, completing Class Eight with determination.
Secondary
Daraja-mbili Secondary School
Joined Nyambera for Form One and completed his Form Four journey at Daraja-mbili Secondary School, laying the foundation for the man he would become.
Business
Fruit Business & Hotel Management
Toto worked diligently alongside his elder brother in the fruit trade, later moving into hotel management — a man of enterprise and hard work.
2021
A Battle Bravely Fought
Diagnosed with diabetes, Toto faced each day with quiet courage and faith. For five years he fought on, in and out of Bosongo Hospital, never losing his spirit.
2026
Gone but Not Forgotten
At the age of 39, Festus Mosirigwa rested from his labours at Bosongo Hospital. He leaves behind a family that loved him deeply and a legacy that will never fade.
Words of Love

Tributes from Those Who Loved Him

Our beloved son, Festus Mosirigwa Nyagw'ara (Toto), you were a blessing from the moment you arrived in 1987. Watching you grow from your early days at St. Peters Academy to the man you became brought us immense pride. We have walked with you through your health struggles since 2021, and though our hearts are broken by your passing at the young age of 39, we find peace knowing you are no longer in pain. You will forever remain in our hearts, and your memory will never fade.

— Nyagw'ara Ombese & Priscah Bochere
Parents

To our dear brother, Toto, we look back with fondness at the memories we shared, from our childhood days to your ventures in business and hotel management. You taught us the value of hard work and resilience, and we truly admired your spirit as you navigated life's challenges. You were a constant presence in our lives, and though you are gone, your strength remains an inspiration to all of us. Rest well, dear brother.

— Brothers
From His Brothers

Our beloved brother, Toto, the loss of your presence leaves a void that is hard to fill. We cherish the memories of growing up together and watching you become the man you were, always striving to support your family. We stood by you through your long battle with your health, witnessing firsthand your courage and perseverance. You will always be deeply loved, and your gentle spirit will live on in our hearts forever. Rest in peace.

— Sisters
From His Sisters

We are deeply saddened by the passing of our brother-in-law, Festus Mosirigwa Nyagw'ara. We will always remember him as a man of great resolve who worked hard in his various business ventures and remained dedicated to his family. Even as he bravely faced his health struggles, his character and warmth left a lasting impression on us. He will be greatly missed, and we honour the legacy of strength he leaves behind.

— Brothers-in-Law
From His Brothers-in-Law

To our dear brother-in-law, Toto, you were a cherished part of our family, and your absence is felt deeply. We admired your industrious nature and your commitment to supporting your family through your work in business and hotel management. We watched your journey with health over these past years with profound respect for your courage. Though you are no longer with us, your kindness will forever be remembered in our hearts as you rest in eternal peace.

— Sisters-in-Law
From His Sisters-in-Law

"Gone but not forgotten."

— The Mosirigwa Family
